messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Be concise and accurate.

Add 1 of those to my cart. Then, get recommendations for that telescope and add 2 units of the first recommended item to my cart. After that, verify my cart contents. Get a shipping quote for this entire cart to 100 Queens Quay E, Toronto, ON, Canada M5V 2H1 in CAD. Finally, execute the checkout using email test@example.com and a test credit card 4432-8015-6152-0454, CVV 123, expiration 01/2030. My user ID is 3f8a2e10-49fe-4b2b-9c7e-0a1b2c3d4e5f.
